_comment: The postcard printer for scripts/print_postcards.py (docs/printing.md). The printer's own address is not kept here: it is found on the local network by ippfind (a service whose name contains find_name) and remembered in .tools/printer.json, or given with --printer. papers: what it can be loaded with; the PDF's page size picks one (postcard.py --paper).
name: Canon SELPHY CP1500
